description: Review Cloudflare application data isolation, authorization paths, and storage-specific security controls.

defaultPrompt: Review this Cloudflare Worker and D1 code for cross-tenant data access risks.
Help me design PostgreSQL RLS policies for a database accessed through Hyperdrive.
Create a security checklist for my Cloudflare app's storage and cache paths.
interface.longDescription: A security review assistant for Cloudflare applications. It helps assess tenant and row-level authorization across Workers, D1, PostgreSQL via Hyperdrive, object and key-value storage, caches, identity boundaries, bindings, and background jobs. It distinguishes D1 application-layer authorization from PostgreSQL native RLS, asks for evidence when needed, and provides prioritized findings and negative tests. It cannot guarantee complete security, inspect an account unless connected evidence is supplied, or deploy changes on its own.

name: cloudflare-data-security
